audio.text: Excuse me, I booked a seat on the 9:30 ferry to Vung Tau, but I just got a text saying it's been delayed.
Yes, I'm sorry about that. There's a problem with the fuel delivery at the dock, so departure is now 10:15.
Oh, that's a shame. I have a meeting at noon.
The crossing takes about an hour and a half, so you should still make it. If you like, I can move you to a seat near the exit.
Actually, yes, please. Is there anywhere to get coffee?
The café on board is closed until the boat is refueled, but there's a kiosk by gate four.
Great, I'll head over there now. Thanks.

questions.q: Why is the woman talking to the man?
options: To buy a ticket for noon
To ask about a schedule change

why.vi: Cô ấy nhận tin nhắn chuyến phà bị hoãn và hỏi nhân viên, tức là hỏi về thay đổi lịch.
why.en: She heard the ferry is delayed and asks about it, so she wants schedule information.

questions.trap: Cô ấy có nhắc cuộc họp lúc 12 giờ nhưng đó không phải lý do cô ấy đến hỏi.

why.vi: Người đàn ông nói có vấn đề giao nhiên liệu ở bến, tức là sự cố cung ứng nhiên liệu.
why.en: He mentions a fuel delivery problem at the dock, paraphrased as a fuel supply issue.

questions.trap: Weather không được nhắc tới; đừng chọn theo suy đoán.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?

why.vi: Cô ấy sẽ đến quầy ki-ốt để mua cà phê, tức là mua đồ uống.
why.en: She will go to the kiosk for coffee, which is buying a drink.

questions.trap: Cô ấy chưa lên phà vì phà còn bị hoãn đến 10:15.

audio.text: Hi, Karen. Did you get my email about the new expense reports?
I saw it this morning, but I haven't opened the attachment yet. Is the form different from last year's?
A little. You have to attach scanned receipts now instead of mailing the paper ones to accounting.
Oh, that'll save time. Who do I send it to?
Directly to Mr. Silva in finance. He said anything submitted by the fifth will be reimbursed this month.
The fifth? That's Friday. I'd better do mine this afternoon, then.
Good idea. And if you can't find a receipt, just write a note explaining what it was for.

why.vi: Họ bàn về cách nộp báo cáo chi phí mới (đính kèm biên lai quét).
why.en: They discuss the changed process for submitting expense reports.

questions.trap: Budget nghe quen vì có chuyện tiền, nhưng không ai nói tăng ngân sách.

why.vi: Giờ phải đính kèm biên lai đã quét thay vì gửi bản giấy.
why.en: Staff now attach scanned copies instead of mailing paper ones.

questions.trap: Mail original receipts là cách cũ, đã bị thay thế.

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do this afternoon?

why.vi: Hạn là thứ Sáu, nên chiều nay cô ấy sẽ nộp báo cáo của mình.
why.en: Since the deadline is Friday, she will do her report today, meaning submit it.

questions.trap: Cô ấy chưa hỏi gì Mr. Silva; cô ấy chỉ nhắc tên người nhận.
